intendedUse: Controlled reproducible traffic scenario simulation, what-if mobility intervention testing (dynamic signal coordination, lane management), and KPI comparison against baseline.
prohibitedClaims: MANDATORY: Simulation outputs must NEVER be represented as field measurements or proof of municipal real-world performance. Physical traffic signals must not be actuated.
knownLimitations: Synthetic demand profiles based on Pune volume survey distributions. Does not account for unmodelled informal lane filtering, road repairs, or unexpected pedestrian mid-block crossings.
privacySensitivityAssessment: Synthetic agent trajectories generated by SUMO random trip generator. Zero personal or surveillance data.
